User.title: User
User.description: Registered platform user profile with role-based access control.

displayName.description: Full display name of the student or administrator.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

role.description: Authorization role assigned to the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin status was granted.

Course.title: Course
Course.description: Educational course metadata supporting free and paid access tiers.

title.description: Course title displayed in catalog and player.

description.description: Detailed course overview and learning outcomes.

thumbnailUrl.description: Course thumbnail URL or asset path.

courseType.description: Access tier indicating whether the course is free or paid.

price.description: Course price in USD (0 for free courses).

isPublished.description: Whether the course is publicly visible in the catalog.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the course was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the course was last updated.

Lesson.title: Lesson
Lesson.description: Video lesson belonging to a course, backed by a validated YouTube Unlisted video ID.

lessonOrder.description: 1-indexed sequence position of the lesson within the course.

isPublished.description: Whether the lesson is published and watchable by enrolled students.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the lesson was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the lesson was last updated.

Enrollment.title: Enrollment
Enrollment.description: Student enrollment record linking a user to a course with explicit access status and bKash Secret Code verification metadata.

accessStatus.description: Current authorization status of the enrollment.

status.description: Uppercase verification status for bKash Secret Code workflow.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used for enrollment (default: bKash).

trxId.description: Optional bKash Transaction ID provided by the student.

senderPhone.description: Optional sender bKash phone number provided by the student.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the purchase/enrollment was initiated.

activatedAt.description: Timestamp when the Secret Code was verified and course access was activated.

enrolledAt.description: Server timestamp when enrollment was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when enrollment was last updated.

LessonProgress.title: LessonProgress
LessonProgress.description: Tracks a student's completion state for an individual lesson.

isCompleted.description: Whether the student has completed the lesson.

completedAt.description: Server timestamp when completion state changed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when progress was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles containing PII (email) and role. Read restricted to owner or admin; self-registration forces student role.

/courses/{courseId}.description: Course catalog records. Published courses are readable by anyone; draft courses and all writes are restricted to admins.

/lessons/{lessonId}.description: Course lessons containing YouTube video IDs. Protected by enrollment and publication checks; writes restricted to admins.

/enrollments/{enrollmentId}.description: Course enrollment records keyed by {userId}_{courseId}. Students may create active enrollments only for published free courses; paid enrollments require admin authorization.

/lessonProgress/{progressId}.description: Student lesson completion records keyed by {userId}_{lessonId}. Strictly isolated to the student owner and admins.
